title: Last 10-minute CCR update
body: Write the most recent 10-minute status update from the CCr session. Cover: what you are currently working on, any decisions made in the last 10 minutes, blockers, and the next action. Timestamp every entry. If nothing changed, say so explicitly rather than repeating stale status.
reply_instructions: Create the replies/ subfolder under COSMOS_BACKUP if it does not exist. Write the update as a JSON file named exactly ccr-update-20260909T1818.json. Include fields: timestamp (ISO-8601), status (one line), working_on (list), decisions (list), blockers (list), next_action (one line). Ara will read it back from Drive.
